test_cpp_tokenizer_discarding_comments: test the CppProcessor tokenizer to tokenize C++ code while discarding comments
test_cpp_tokenizer_keep_comments: test the CppProcessor tokenizer to tokenize C++ code while keeping comments as tokens
test_extract_cpp_functions: test extracting standalone and class member functions from tokenized C++ source code
test_cpp_detokenize: test detokenizing C++ token lists back into formatted source code with comments removed
test_formatter: test formatting minified C++ code into properly indented and spaced source code
